author: Unreal Engine
description:
Twelve months ago, Epic’s Ben Kidd began his journey with performance capture—and he’s learned a lot along the way, thanks to Epic's team of virtual production veterans and engineers. 

In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Stockholm, Ben shares his journey and learnings so you can get up to speed capturing AAA-quality performances in no time!

The talk covers performance capture from low to high budget (indies to large studios). It will give beginners the confidence to get started with performance capture in Unreal Engine, and it will reveal new tools and workflows that more advanced users may not be aware of.

Learn more about Unreal Engine here: unrealengine.com

#PerformanceCapture, #MotionCapture, #VirtualProduction, #UnrealEngine, #UE5, #UnrealFestStockholm
title: A Guide to Getting Into Performance Capture | Unreal Fest Stockholm 2025
